item.title: Propose a Shared Equipment Storage Policy
item.prompt_text: Residents have asked for indoor storage space for their own equipment. Some need a large space for bulky equipment they use weekly. Others would like a small space for items they use every day. The building has 18 identical sections of shelving and limited staff time. Propose a system that handles different sizes, keeps the application process short, and gives people a way to revise their allocation when their needs change.
item.audience: committee members at a community sports building
item.target_grammar: Concessive structures and precise conditionals. Use nominal phrases to name procedures.
item.target_structure: Define the allocation unit, describe two contrasting cases, and specify a review and appeal procedure.

checklist.point: Explain how storage will be allocated across different equipment sizes.
Make the application short and easy to check.
Set out a transparent way to handle competing demand.
Provide a low-friction way to change an allocation.
